# Newark Quality Roofing

> Newark Quality Roofing is a roofing contractor serving Newark, NJ and surrounding Essex County communities. The company provides roof repair, roof replacement, emergency roof repair, roof leak repair, roof inspection, storm damage repair, and related residential and commercial roofing services. Per the homepage, most repairs run $350-$1,500, full replacements run $8,500-$25,000+, and free estimates are offered. Phone: (973) 649-9535.
